network_fee_policy.note: Target estimated total network fee is 1 TON. Absolute Founder-set maximum is 3 TON. Sum all source and destination fee components from a valid estimate; do not count attached deployment value as a fee. Missing, malformed, stale, or unsuccessful estimates must fail closed. Do not sign or broadcast if total estimated network fee exceeds 3 TON. Re-estimate immediately before signing; never split or retry transactions to bypass the cap.
